Verified live: 0.0->0.6% (root DI) -> 0.71% (sub puente cumulative) -> 1.04% (Bomba cumulative).

RebtCuadroStep.jsx: recursive JSX flattened via collect() + updateAt()/removeAt() JS helpers. No stack overflow; boards render with marginLeft: depth*16. All data-testid present and functional (board-{id}, board-{id}-add-carga/dif/sub, carga-{id}-*, rm-sub-{id}).

Nit (not a bug): newBoard(false) creates a subcuadro with one default empty carga (potencia=''). When the user adds a sub-panel and then also clicks 'add-carga' without deleting the default, a P=0 circuit is calculated -> No cumple. Consider either (a) creating subcuadros with cargas:[] and requiring user to click add-carga, or (b) validating potencia>0 with client-side warning. Current behavior is consistent with root board initial state so probably intentional.
